name: Spiral Minaret
summary: Three curved tiers rise beside a low domed prayer hall, giving the mosque a distinctive sculptural rhythm.
why: The minaret widens through three generous spiral-like tiers, separated by real open gaps. A compact dome, prayer hall, and open doorway ground the tower as a mosque. Clay and rose tones give the architecture a warm, tactile presence.
risk: The spiral is an abstract interpretation rather than a literal building. At 24 pixels the tiers become a bold stepped tower, while the small dome is secondary.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque with an unusual sculptural minaret.
